fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 150 days after arrival and have at least one blank page.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe caducar al menos 150 días después de la llegada y tener al menos una página en blanco.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 150 days after the date you arrive and at least 1 blank page.

entry.en: You must not take Turkish lira worth more than 5000 US dollars out of the country.
entry.es: No se pueden sacar del país liras turcas por un valor superior a 5000 dólares estadounidenses.
entry.quote: You must not take Turkish lira worth more than 5000 US dollars out of the country.

entry.en: There is no limit on the amount of foreign currency or Turkish lira you can take into Turkey.
entry.es: No hay límite a la cantidad de moneda extranjera o liras turcas que se pueden introducir en Turquía.
entry.quote: There is no limit on the amount of foreign currency or Turkish lira you can take into Turkey.

entry.en: Dual British-Turkish children aged 18 or younger may need permission from the Turkish parent to leave Turkey.
entry.es: Los niños con doble nacionalidad británica y turca de 18 años o menos pueden necesitar el permiso del progenitor turco para salir de Turquía.
entry.quote: If leaving Turkey with a dual British-Turkish national child who is 18 or younger, you may need to show permission to travel from the Turkish parent.

entry.en: Day trips to Greek islands fall under the EU Entry Exit System, which may take each passenger a few extra minutes.
entry.es: Las excursiones de un día a islas griegas están sujetas al Sistema de Entradas y Salidas de la UE, que puede llevar unos minutos más a cada pasajero.
entry.quote: EES may take each passenger a few extra minutes to complete, so be prepared to wait longer than usual at the border.

safety.en: Street robbery and pickpocketing are common in the major tourist areas of Istanbul.
safety.es: El robo en la calle y los carteristas son frecuentes en las principales zonas turísticas de Estambul.
safety.quote: Street robbery and pickpocketing are common in the major tourist areas of Istanbul.

safety.en: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Turkey.
safety.es: Es probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Turquía.
safety.quote: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Turkey.

safety.en: Regular demonstrations take place in Istanbul and other cities, may become violent, and should be avoided.
safety.es: Se celebran manifestaciones con regularidad en Estambul y otras ciudades, pueden volverse violentas y conviene evitarlas.
safety.quote: Regular demonstrations and protests are currently taking place in Istanbul and other cities across Turkey. Demonstrations may become violent.

safety.en: Methanol in illegally produced or counterfeit alcohol has caused deaths and serious illness in Turkey, including Ankara and Istanbul.
safety.es: El metanol en alcohol ilegal o falsificado ha causado muertes y enfermedades graves en Turquía, incluidas Ankara y Estambul.
safety.quote: In Turkey, including Ankara and Istanbul, people have died or suffered serious illness after drinking illegally produced local spirits and counterfeit bottles of branded alcohol.

safety.en: The FCDO advises against all travel within 10km of the Turkey-Syria border.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a menos de 10 km de la frontera entre Turquía y Siria.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel within 10km of the Turkey-Syria border.

safety.en: Accepting lifts from drivers of unofficial taxis is highly risky, so use a registered taxi with a metered fare.
safety.es: Aceptar viajes de conductores de taxis no oficiales es muy arriesgado, por lo que conviene usar un taxi registrado con taxímetro.
safety.quote: Accepting lifts from drivers of unofficial taxis is highly risky. Find a registered taxi, note the registration number before entering and ensure the fare is metered.

health.en: British prescriptions are not accepted in pharmacies in Turkey.
health.es: Las recetas británicas no se aceptan en las farmacias de Turquía.
health.quote: British prescriptions are not accepted in pharmacies in Turkey.

health.en: The European Health Insurance Card and Global Health Insurance card are not valid in Turkey.
health.es: La Tarjeta Sanitaria Europea y la tarjeta Global Health Insurance no son válidas en Turquía.
health.quote: The European Health Insurance Card  and Global Health Insurance card are not valid in Turkey.

health.en: Wikivoyage says tap water is generally not pleasant to drink and no one guarantees it is safe, so bottled water is better.
health.es: Wikivoyage indica que el agua del grifo generalmente no es agradable de beber y nadie garantiza que sea segura, por lo que es mejor el agua embotellada.
health.quote: Tap water, including that that comes out of the historical public fountains (çeşme) or mosque fountains (şadırvan), generally isn't pleasant to drink

health.en: Wikivoyage says travel health insurance is highly recommended because better private hospitals operate on a user-pays basis.
health.es: Wikivoyage dice que se recomienda mucho un seguro médico de viaje porque los mejores hospitales privados funcionan con pago del usuario.
health.quote: Travel health insurance is highly recommended because the better private hospitals operate under the "user pays" principle

health.en: Most towns and cities have stray dogs that can be aggressive, and rabies is present in Turkey.
health.es: La mayoría de las ciudades tienen perros callejeros que pueden ser agresivos, y en Turquía hay rabia.
health.quote: Rabies and other animal borne diseases are present in Turkey.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Turkey.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas partes de Turquía.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Turkey.

help.en: The emergency number in Turkey for ambulance, fire and police is 112.
help.es: El número de emergencias en Turquía para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 112.

help.en: FCDO in London can be called 24 hours a day about urgent problems affecting a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Se puede llamar al FCDO en Londres las 24 horas por problemas urgentes de un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.
help.quote: You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.

getting_in.en: Istanbul Airport (IST), opened in 2018, is Turkey's chief international gateway by air.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Estambul (IST), inaugurado en 2018, es la principal puerta de entrada aérea internacional de Turquía.
getting_in.quote: Turkey's chief international gateway by air is Istanbul Airport (IST IATA), opened in 2018.

getting_in.en: Sabiha Gökçen Airport (SAW) is Istanbul's second airport, on the Asian side, and is used particularly by budget airlines such as Pegasus.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto Sabiha Gökçen (SAW) es el segundo de Estambul, en el lado asiático, y lo usan sobre todo aerolíneas de bajo coste como Pegasus.
getting_in.quote: Sabiha Gökçen Airport (SAW IATA), 50 km east of central Istanbul on the Asian side. It is particularly used by budget airlines such as Pegasus.

getting_in.en: Ferries run several times a week across the Black Sea from Chornomorske in Ukraine to Karasu and Istanbul.
getting_in.es: Hay ferris varias veces por semana a través del Mar Negro desde Chornomorske, en Ucrania, hasta Karasu y Estambul.
getting_in.quote: To Karasu (near Adapazarı) and Istanbul there are ferries several times a week across the Black Sea from Chornomorske

getting_around.en: Turkey has a very good long-distance bus network with air-conditioned buses and reserved seats.
getting_around.es: Turquía tiene una muy buena red de autobuses de larga distancia con autobuses con aire acondicionado y asientos reservados.
getting_around.quote: Turkey has a very good long-distance bus network with air-conditioned buses, reserved seats and generally good-quality service

getting_around.en: Domestic air travel is well developed, with hourly flights between Istanbul and Ankara.
getting_around.es: Los vuelos nacionales están muy desarrollados, con vuelos cada hora entre Estambul y Ankara.
getting_around.quote: There are flights between Istanbul and Ankara hourly

getting_around.en: The very fast YHT trains take under 5 hours from Istanbul to Ankara or Konya.
getting_around.es: Los trenes de alta velocidad YHT tardan menos de 5 horas de Estambul a Ankara o Konya.
getting_around.quote: Thus, from Istanbul it’s under 5 hours to Ankara or Konya.

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage says scammers wait in and before bus stations, and some may help you buy a ticket for a bus that will not depart soon.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage dice que hay estafadores dentro y antes de las estaciones de autobuses, y algunos pueden ayudarte a comprar un billete para un autobús que no sale pronto.
getting_around.quote: Be careful, scammers will be waiting for you in and before bus stations

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage suggests avoiding taxis departing from the bus station (otogar) and taking one from outside the terminal instead.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage sugiere evitar los taxis que salen de la estación de autobuses (otogar) y tomar uno fuera de la terminal.
getting_around.quote: If you have to take a taxi, it is usually suggested that you do it from outside the bus terminal.

money.en: The currency is the Turkish lira, with the ISO code TRY.
money.es: La moneda es la lira turca, con el código ISO TRY.
money.quote: The currency of the country is the Turkish lira, denoted by the symbol "₺" or "TL" (ISO code: TRY).

money.en: Visa and MasterCard are widely accepted, while American Express is accepted much less.
money.es: Visa y MasterCard se aceptan ampliamente, mientras que American Express se acepta mucho menos.
money.quote: Visa and MasterCard are widely accepted, American Express much less so.

money.en: ATMs are widely available in Turkish cities, and any major town will have at least one.
money.es: Los cajeros automáticos abundan en las ciudades turcas, y cualquier población importante tiene al menos uno.
money.quote: ATMs are widely available in Turkish cities, particularly in central areas and any major town will have at least one ATM.

money.en: DCC ATMs force an exchange rate with a markup of 7% or more and should be avoided whenever possible.
money.es: Los cajeros DCC imponen un tipo de cambio con un recargo del 7% o más y conviene evitarlos siempre que sea posible.
money.quote: force you to accept an extortionate exchange rate with a markup of 7% or more.

money.en: Tipping is not obligatory, but leaving a 10% tip in restaurants is very common if you are satisfied with the service.
money.es: La propina no es obligatoria, pero es muy habitual dejar un 10% en los restaurantes si el servicio ha sido satisfactorio.
money.quote: In general, tipping is not considered obligatory. However, it is very common to leave a 10% tip in restaurants if you're satisfied with the service.

money.en: Bargaining is a must in souvenir shops in touristy areas and in carpet shops everywhere.
money.es: Regatear es imprescindible en las tiendas de recuerdos de zonas turísticas y en las tiendas de alfombras de todas partes.
money.quote: In Turkey, bargaining is a must — particularly in souvenir shops in touristy areas and carpet shops everywhere

etiquette.en: Dress modestly when visiting a mosque or a religious shrine.
etiquette.es: Viste con modestia al visitar una mezquita o un santuario religioso.
etiquette.quote: Dress modestly if you’re visiting a mosque or a religious shrine to avoid causing offence.

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage says all footwear should be removed before entering any mosque.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage dice que hay que quitarse todo el calzado antes de entrar en cualquier mezquita.
etiquette.quote: All footwear should be removed before entering any mosque.

etiquette.en: Insulting the Turkish nation, the flag, the President or Atatürk is illegal and punishable by 6 months to 3 years in prison.
etiquette.es: Insultar a la nación turca, la bandera, al presidente o a Atatürk es ilegal y se castiga con entre 6 meses y 3 años de prisión.
etiquette.quote: Offences under these laws are punishable by a prison sentence of between 6 months and 3 years.

etiquette.en: It is illegal not to carry some form of photographic ID in Turkey.
etiquette.es: En Turquía es ilegal no llevar alguna forma de documento de identidad con fotografía.
etiquette.quote: It is illegal not to carry some form of photographic ID in Turkey.

etiquette.en: Do not photograph military or official installations, and ask permission before photographing people.
etiquette.es: No fotografíes instalaciones militares u oficiales y pide permiso antes de fotografiar a personas.
etiquette.quote: Do not take photographs of or near military or official installations. Ask for permission before photographing people.

etiquette.en: When invited into a Turkish home, take your shoes off just outside or immediately inside the door.
etiquette.es: Si te invitan a una casa turca, quítate los zapatos justo fuera o dentro de la puerta.
etiquette.quote: When you arrive at the house take off your shoes just outside or immediately inside the door

connectivity.en: Access to some e-sim services is restricted in Turkey, so check with your provider before travelling.
connectivity.es: El acceso a algunos servicios de e-sim está restringido en Turquía, así que consulta con tu operador antes de viajar.
connectivity.quote: Access to some e-sim services is restricted in Turkey. Check with your provider before travelling.

connectivity.en: Wikivoyage says the three main mobile providers are Vodafone, Turkcell and Türk Telekom.
connectivity.es: Wikivoyage indica que los tres principales operadores móviles son Vodafone, Turkcell y Türk Telekom.
connectivity.quote: Providers include Vodafone, Turkcell, or Türk Telekom.

connectivity.en: Wikivoyage says some webpages are blocked by court order and a VPN or Tor can be used to bypass the blocks.
connectivity.es: Wikivoyage dice que algunas páginas web están bloqueadas por orden judicial y se puede usar una VPN o Tor para sortear los bloqueos.
connectivity.quote: You can also use a VPN or Tor to bypass the blocks.

connectivity.en: Wikivoyage says free public Wi-Fi is offered by most municipalities, mainly in city centers and squares.
connectivity.es: Wikivoyage dice que la mayoría de los municipios ofrecen wifi público gratuito, sobre todo en centros y plazas de las ciudades.
connectivity.quote: Free public Wi-Fi is offered by most municipalities, mainly in city centers and squares.
